application_materials: Complete the online graduate application for the external CSE MS program.
Upload academic transcripts for the institutions attended as required by the checklist.
Submit a statement of purpose, three recommendation letters, and a resume or CV.
Provide required English proficiency evidence or obtain confirmation of a qualifying exemption.
Confirm eligibility with UC San Diego if you already hold an advanced degree at the same level.

directory_policies.notes.9: Application checklist: Online application, transcripts, statement of purpose, three recommendations, resume or CV, and applicable English evidence. Duplicate advanced degrees and exemptions require separate review.

source_excerpt: Three (3) letters of recommendation are required
fact_summary: The CSE checklist includes an online application, academic records, statement of purpose, three recommendation letters, resume or CV, and English proficiency documentation as applicable. Institutional eligibility and special-case review remain separate.
